name: Data center policy
mech: Land Use, Zoning, Water, Noise, Ban
desc: Fredericksburg's data center policy uses a new Technology Overlay District to allow smaller centers by-right while mandating strict environmental buffers, noise controls, and visual shielding from the Rappahannock River. Larger projects require a special permit and must adhere to comprehensive setback rules, a ban on potable water for cooling, and advanced generator standards to minimize pollution

name: Data center planning
desc: King George County's data center ordinance was a local zoning amendment initiated by county planning staff and reviewed by the Planning Commission before final approval by the Board of Supervisors. It primarily functions as a zoning and land-use mechanism that allows and regulates data center development within designated industrial areas of the county.

name: Chapter 86 – Zoning & Subdivision Ordinance
desc: Zoning ordinance amendments embedded in Chapter 86, which were adopted in multiple updates between 2025 and 2026. These changes determine where data centers can be built by classifying them under industrial or conditional land-use categories rather than creating a standalone data center law.
